tasks.old_behavior: The get_job_options() function validates the "term_finish" option of term_start(). Previously, only "open" and "close" were accepted as valid values. Passing "noclose" would cause an E475 error: "Invalid value for argument "term_finish": noclose".
tasks.new_behavior: The validation is relaxed to also accept "noclose" as a valid value for "term_finish". When set, the terminal window will not close (and no window will be opened) when the job finishes. The buffer remains hidden, listed, and loaded with terminal output available.
tasks.compatibility_reason: This is an additive (relaxed) input contract change. The set of accepted values for the "term_finish" option of term_start() is expanded from {"open", "close"} to {"open", "close", "noclose"}. No existing callers are broken since previously "noclose" would simply error. However, Vimscript code that string-checks valid term_finish values may need updating if it validates against a hard-coded list.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run existing terminal finish tests (open/close) to verify no regression. Run the new "noclose" test which verifies that a terminal with term_finish=noclose keeps the buffer hidden, listed, and loaded after job completion.
